title: XZ Utils backdoor (liblzma supply chain compromise)
description: Vulnerable liblzma package version detected during authenticated scan; potential for remote code execution via crafted SSH sessions.

title: Windows SmartScreen security feature bypass
description: Unpatched SmartScreen bypass allows malicious files to evade warning prompts; actively exploited in phishing campaigns.

title: Windows MSHTML platform remote code execution
description: Legacy patch level allows RCE via crafted document; endpoint flagged as compromised in active incident.

title: PHP-CGI argument injection remote code execution
description: Outdated PHP-CGI configuration vulnerable to argument injection allowing arbitrary code execution on Windows-based PHP deployments.

title: FortiOS SSL VPN out-of-bounds write
description: Out-of-bounds write vulnerability in FortiOS SSL-VPN could allow unauthenticated remote code execution.

title: OpenSSH regreSSHion race condition RCE
description: Signal handler race condition in OpenSSH server allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root under certain conditions.

title: OpenSSH regreSSHion race condition RCE
description: Same OpenSSH vulnerability present on second application instance; scheduled for the same patch window.

title: WinRAR remote code execution via crafted archive
description: Legacy WinRAR installation vulnerable to code execution when a user opens a specially crafted archive file.

title: Cisco NX-OS CLI command injection
description: Authenticated attacker could execute arbitrary commands on the underlying OS via crafted CLI input.

title: libexpat XML parser out-of-bounds read
description: Dependency scan flagged transitive libexpat dependency with known parsing vulnerability in checkout service.

title: Windows Hyper-V privilege escalation
description: Local privilege escalation vulnerability in Hyper-V component present on executive laptop image.

title: Azure Kubernetes Service confidential container information disclosure
description: Misconfiguration flagged by cloud posture scan permitting potential credential exposure between container boundaries.
